product: A sellable multi-theme template pack. One shared system, eight distinct looks.
note: This replaces the 60-brief exercise catalogue (archived). The axes are POSITIVE design directions, not deprivations. Every theme must clear the quality bar in docs/PACK.md before it counts as shipped. Each theme is built once; status moves unbuilt -> in-progress -> built -> (VALIDATE.md present) reviewed.

axes.vertical: the buyer — who would pay for this theme
axes.direction: the positive visual target, with a named reference register
axes.pages: every page the theme ships; a one-pager does not sell
axes.signature: the one thing a buyer remembers about this theme

themes.name: Vela
themes.direction: techno-minimal — precise, dense, confident. Deep ink ground, one electric accent, hairline rules, generous negative space around tight type.

type.pairing_note: Grotesk display at tight tracking over Inter at 1.6 line-height

themes.signature: a glowing product frame in the hero, built entirely in CSS

themes.name: Marrow
themes.direction: editorial-luxe — magazine restraint applied to hospitality. Ivory paper, oxblood, a high-contrast serif at display size, full-bleed photography with text overlaid at the margins.

type.pairing_note: Serif display very large and tight; sans body small and wide-tracked for labels

themes.signature: the menu page — typography doing all the work, no decoration

themes.name: Atlas Works
themes.direction: soft-brutalist — oversized type, offset blocks, visible grid, one loud accent. Confident rather than shouty: hard edges with warm paper and real shadows.

type.pairing_note: Variable display pushed to its widest and tightest; body kept plain

themes.signature: project cards that reveal a second layer on hover, no JavaScript

themes.name: Sable
themes.direction: architectural — stone and glass. Muted neutrals, very large photography, thin rules, numbers treated as a design element. Calm, expensive, unhurried.

type.pairing_note: Fraunces at low optical size for warmth; Manrope for specs and figures

themes.signature: the listing detail page — specs set like a technical drawing

themes.name: Kinfold
themes.direction: warm-organic — sage and clay, generous radii, soft layered shadows, rounded photography, lots of air. Reassuring without being saccharine.

type.pairing_note: Geometric sans display at medium weight; nothing sharp anywhere

themes.signature: layered soft shadows and an offset hero image that feels physical

themes.name: Orbit
themes.direction: high-contrast gradient — dark ground, vivid gradient mesh, translucent cards with real backdrop blur. The one theme in the pack that is allowed to be flashy, done with restraint.

type.pairing_note: Sora tight and heavy for the date and title; Inter for schedule density

themes.signature: a CSS-only gradient mesh behind glass cards, no images needed

themes.name: Ridgeline
themes.direction: nature-earthy — forest, sand and slate. Full-bleed landscape photography, heavy slab-ish display type, sturdy components that look like they could take weather.

type.pairing_note: Syne heavy and wide for headlines; Inter for product detail

themes.signature: the product page — retail detail that still feels like a magazine

themes.name: Monogram
themes.direction: refined monochrome — near-black on warm white, one display face at enormous size, immaculate spacing. The restrained one, and the hardest to get right.

type.pairing_note: Playfair at 10rem+ with tight leading; everything else quiet

themes.signature: the homepage headline — one sentence, set perfectly
